title: Best Robot Vacuum Cleaners UK
short: Robot vacuums and vacuum-mop combos compared by suction, docking, mopping and who they suit.
intro: Robot vacuums now range from simple budget models to fully automated machines that empty, wash and refill themselves. This guide draws on Expert Reviews, which tests every robot on the same 58m² floorplan with rice, flour and pet hair spills, and on Mumsnet, whose editors and home testers have tried more than 20 models in real family homes, so you can decide which features are worth paying for in your home.

products.name: Omni E25
products.best_for: Most homes that want vacuuming and mopping with a self-emptying dock
products.key_spec: LiDAR and camera, mops, self-emptying dock
products.summary: Expert Reviews rates this the best robot vacuum it has tested. It cleaned 90% of flour, rice and dog hair on carpet and hard floor in its tests, mops hard floors well and empties, cleans and charges itself after every run.

specs.Battery: 216 min vacuum only, 125 min vacuum and mop

pros: Cleans carpets and hard floors thoroughly

products.name: E20
products.best_for: Buyers who want a robot vacuum and a cordless stick in one
products.summary: Expert Reviews' best-value pick doubles as a cordless stick vacuum, so you get two cleaners in one, with a self-emptying dock.

specs.Runtime: 180 min as robot, 49 min as stick (eco)

pros: Cordless stick and robot in one
cons: Not the best at any single job

products.name: Omni S2
products.best_for: Buyers who want the best cleaning and design regardless of price
products.summary: Expert Reviews' best premium vacuum-and-mop. It picked up 99% of the rice and flour in its tests on carpet and hard floor, cleaned faster than most robots it has tried and kept mopping stains until they were gone. Its only real drawback is the price.
pros: The most elegant robot vacuum money can buy
cons: Detergent and fragrance modules must come from Eufy

products.name: Saros 20 Neo
products.best_for: Cluttered homes with cables, pets and low furniture
products.summary: Expert Reviews' pick for object detection. It avoids cable nests and plastic bags, marks pets and objects in the app, and its retractable LiDAR turret lets it slip under low furniture. It cleaned and mopped most test stains and empties itself after every run.
pros: Excellent AI object and pet detection

products.name: X10 Pro Omni
products.best_for: Homes with pets and a mix of carpet and hard floor
products.summary: The best robot vacuum Mumsnet has tested, and also its pick for pet hair. Its home tester praised the powerful vacuuming, pet-hair pickup, mapping and the dock that empties the bin, cleans the mop pads and refills the water. The mop suits everyday upkeep rather than dried-on stains.

specs.Runtime: 170 min vacuum only, 130 min vacuum and mop

pros: Excellent at hair removal, including pet hair
Self-emptying and refilling station with a self-cleaning mop
Great at avoiding stairs, obstacles and no-go zones
cons: App can be tricky to use
products.search: Eufy X10 Pro Omni robot vacuum

products.name: Omni C28
products.best_for: Homes with lots of hard floor where mopping matters as much as vacuuming
products.summary: Mumsnet's pick for mopping. Its editor found the roller mop scrubs and cleans itself as it goes rather than dragging a damp cloth around, with reliably solid vacuuming and navigation that rarely needs rescuing. Dried-on dirt may need a second pass, and the dock's drying cycle is long and loud.
pros: Strong suction and reliable everyday cleaning
Self-cleaning mop gives a decent clean on hard surfaces
Docking station handles all the messy jobs
More affordable than rivals with similar features
cons: Dock drying cycle is lengthy and quite loud
products.search: Eufy Omni C28 robot vacuum mop

products.name: Spot+Scrub AI
products.best_for: Busy homes with lots of hard flooring and a generous budget
products.summary: Mumsnet's high-end pick. In its editor's family home it cleared crushed cornflakes and removed dried-on food from kitchen tiles in one pass, mapped the home in a single run and steered around toys and cables. At 11cm tall it could not get under some lower furniture, and the dock is bulky.
pros: Excellent hard floor cleaning and mopping
cons: Too tall to fit under some furniture
Side brushes can detach on rugs
Dyson cleaning solution recommended and sold separately

products.name: T20 Pro
products.best_for: Buyers who want mapping, mopping and self-emptying without top-tier pricing
products.summary: Mumsnet's best-value pick: a vacuum-and-mop combo with LiDAR mapping, a self-emptying dock and an app its tester found intuitive, with no-go zones. The mop is better at day-to-day upkeep than stubborn stains.
pros: Effective on carpets and hard floors
cons: Navigation can be clunky compared to smarter models
products.search: Ultenic T20 Pro robot vacuum mop

products.name: 360 Vis Nav
products.best_for: Buyers who want strong suction and do not need mopping or self-emptying
products.summary: Expert Reviews now lists this under 'also tested' with a 4/5 rating rather than among its top picks. Its full review praises the powerful vacuuming and unique fluffy roller, but it has no mop, no self-emptying dock and a very high price.
cons: Bin must be emptied by hand

products.name: M210P
products.best_for: Small homes and first-time buyers on a tight budget
products.summary: Mumsnet's best budget robot vacuum: a basic, quiet and affordable model with four cleaning modes that works well on pet hair. It lacks room mapping, has lower suction than pricier models and can get caught on tasselled rugs.
pros: Easy to control through the app
cons: Not as powerful as some other robot vacuums

products.name: K11+
products.summary: Mumsnet's best small robot vacuum, replacing the Mini K10+ it reviewed in depth. It is a compact model with laser mapping, great edge cleaning and a self-emptying bin that Mumsnet says lasts up to 70 days before the bag needs changing.
pros: Easy to use and set up
cons: Mops using a disposable wipe rather than mop brushes

guide.q: Do I need a self-emptying dock?
guide.a: A self-emptying dock stores dust in a larger bag or bin, so you only deal with it every few weeks. It costs more and takes more floor space, but it makes the vacuum genuinely hands-off.

guide.q: Is suction power (Pa) the most important number?
guide.a: Not on its own. Pa figures are not measured consistently between brands, so treat them as a rough guide. Navigation, brush design and how well the robot handles edges and carpets often matter more in real homes.

guide.q: Do robot vacuums with mops replace mopping by hand?
guide.a: They are good for keeping light dirt down between deeper cleans. Reviewers note that some struggle with dried-on stains, so expect to spot-clean the tougher marks.

guide.q: Will a robot vacuum cope with pets?
guide.a: Look for a model with anti-tangle brushes and strong pet hair results in tests, and be ready to empty the bin more often. Pet accidents on the floor are the one thing to keep robots away from.
